abstract: Version-specific guide for upgrading a Capacitor app from v8 to the v9 prerelease: tooling preflight (Node 24, Xcode 27, Android Studio 2026.1.1), UIScene prerequisite, cap migrate, iOS 16 and @main, removed CAPBridge APIs, AGP 9.2.1 / Gradle 9.5.1 / SDK 37 Android changes, plugin and CLI changes, and grep-based verification.
